ModMetaData.name: Date Night
ModMetaData.author: AzraelGodKing
ModMetaData.description:
Adds a Lovin timetable slot to the Schedule tab.
Paint Lovin on both partners for the same hours. Each colonist goes to their bed and waits. When both are in a shared double bed, lovin uses a short mean-time-between (like the vanilla Always Do Lovin debug option) until the schedule changes — then behavior returns to normal.
Adults without a partner in that bed can have some private time in any bed (including a single). No pregnancy. Toggle it off in mod settings.
Works for no-sleep / low-rest pawns who never hit a Sleep block: Lovin still sends them to bed.
REQUIREMENTS - Couples: both scheduled Lovin, love relationship, shared double bed. - Private time: adult colonist, Lovin hours, a reachable bed. Children never qualify.
SETTINGS - Pregnancy-safe cooldown (default ON): keeps vanilla post-lovin cooldown; only shortens the chance MTB while scheduled. - Eager mode (optional): also shortens post-lovin cooldown like Always Do Lovin — can spam pregnancy rolls. - Allow private time (default ON): self-lovin when a partner is not sharing a double.
Requires Harmony. RimWorld 1.6. Safe to add mid-save. Before removing: clear Lovin schedule slots back to Sleep/Anything.
